name: Debt Mark
description: Brush a foe with a faint thread of qi and feel how much harm they have lately done.

name: Tally Touch
description: Tap the foe once and keep the tally so that the next blow they land costs them a little.

name: Owed Sting
description: Flick a small bead of qi that stings the foe by about as much as they have just stung another.

name: Even Hand
description: Meet a blow with an open hand of equal weight and let it slide away unharmed.

name: Small Toll
description: Draw a small toll of qi from the foe each time they swing at the user.

name: Echo Blow
description: Take a light blow on the forearm and send a small echo of it back into the striker.

name: Return Tap
description: Tap the striker on the same spot where they struck and with about the same weight.

name: Recoil Guard
description: Hold a guard that jars the arm of anyone who strikes it hard.

name: Rebound Step
description: Step back from a blow and spring forward on its rebound.

name: Due Sting
description: Send back a sharp bead of qi as the due answer to a thrown missile.

name: Fair Answer
description: Gather the sting of a blow taken and hold it ready to repay on the next strike.

name: Weigh Glance
description: Weigh with a glance how much harm the target has done in the last few days.

name: Reckon Palm
description: Press a flat palm on the chest with a weight set by the harm the foe has lately given.

name: Burden Sense
description: Read from a person's stance the weight they carry from their own past deeds.

name: Fair Stride
description: Step so that the weight sits even on both feet and no blow finds it unbalanced.

name: Guilt Burden
description: Lay a light burden of guilt on the foe's qi so that each swing comes a breath slow.

name: Fair Warning
description: Show the foe a flicker of the harm that waits for them and make them hesitate.

name: Steady Tally
description: Keep a calm running count of blows given and taken so that the user's reply stays exact.

name: Ledger Guard
description: Hold a plain guard that answers each blow with a matching push back.

name: Fair Strike
description: Strike once with the weight of the last blow taken and no more.

name: Count Back
description: Count the force of a blow as it lands and give back the same measure through the guard arm.

name: Equal Measure
description: Loose a bead of qi weighed to match the harm just done to the user.
